newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks ends higher on rebound after falls.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks ends higher on rebound after falls.

text.p: South Korean stocks ended firmer on Saturday on a technical rebound following recent sharp falls, brokers said.
The composite index rose 9.02 points to 768.37. Advancers outnumbered decliners 493 to 351.
"Large-cap shares, which led falls in the composite index in recent sessions, recovered on a technical rebound, contributing to boosting the market," a broker with LG Securities said.
Brokers said a decline in the index is likely early next week with no major market-boosting factors in sight. Concerns about margin loans would also depress the market, they added.
